# How to Find Contract Details

In TWS, you can right click the symbol and click "Financial Instrument Info" – "Description" or "Details" to find the target contract details information.

![TWS right-click menu showcasing Financial Instrument Info.](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/campus/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/09/contrac-detail.png)

![TWS Description window displaying the contract details for AAPL.](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/campus/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/09/contrac-detail2-700x585.png)
